newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares active as show further gains.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares active as show further gains.

text.p: Lithuanian shares made further gains in active trade on Monday, with Hermis Bank and Ukio Bank showing rises, dealers said.
The group A index of the 35 most active shares gained 119.92 points to 2,049.08 with volume on the central market totalling 1.07 million litas.
Bloc trades worth 1.99 million litas were carried out but there was no trade on the secondary T-bill market.
Hermis Bank, one of the top three banks, rose to 221 litas from 206 on turnover of 140,114 litas on the central market and 1.64 million litas in bloc trades.
Its bloc trades were done in a range of 220-204 litas.
Ukio Bank gained to 26.4 litas from 22 on trade of 25,317 litas while Siauliai Bank rose to 73 litas from 70 on turnover of 80,446 litas.
Lithuanian Gas remained firm and went up to 1.6 litas from 1.55 and turned over 129,982 litas on the central market and 102,300 litas in bloc trades done at 1.65 litas.
Birzai Milk was unchanged at nine litas on trade of 286,875 litas.
